metrics.window_convention: WP-12ci / WP-S2c-41 uses the second annual local-data evaluation window, 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, as H-006 combined R1+R2 cycle 2 after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline and WP-12ch final-local-data-year cycle 1. The window follows committed H-004, H-001, H-005, and H-006 annual backward-window precedent: cycle 1 used 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, so cycle 2 uses the immediately prior fully covered annual window. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 30m history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in.
